parameters.name: EnvConf
parameters.description: The configurations of the specified environment.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the routine. The name must be unique among the routines that belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn create-routine --name test --description the_description_of_this_routine --env-conf production={"SpecName":"50ms"} staging={"SpecName":"50ms"} --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn CreateRoutine --region cn-hangzhou --Description the_description_of_this_routine --EnvConf '{"production":{"SpecName":"50ms"},"staging":{"SpecName":"50ms"}}' --Name test
